usefulness.rationale: Understanding (2): A reader comes away with a solid picture of who Hilary Cottam is — British social entrepreneur, founder of Participle (2006), former director of the Design Council's RED unit, author of Radical Help (2018) and The Work We Need, UK Designer of the Year 2005, WEF Young Global Leader, and currently leading a DEFRA review (2025). However, the dossier is contaminated: an entire block of claims (source 6c496f56…) is about Anne Longfield (former Children's Commissioner, CBE 2021, book 'Young Lives, Big Ambitions'), and another cluster (source 9f970c17…) is about Marc Stears, neither of whom is Cottam. Numerous placeholder claims with the literal statement 'statement' add noise. These defects stop it from being a clean 3. RemainingQuestions (2): The status labels (contested/claimed/unknown/supported) and the registry provenance notes ('Participation only…', 'Registry membership only…') do flag what is unverified, which is genuine epistemic hygiene; but there is no explicit statement of what the dossier does not know (e.g., whether Participle still operates, dates for the World Bank/UNICEF periods, no disambiguation of the Longfield/Stears material as out-of-scope). ConversationReadiness (2): A reader could prepare for a meeting — current work (DEFRA review on upland communities, The Work We Need, UCL IIPP visiting professorship), core ideas (relational welfare, relationships-first service design), recognition, and connections (Gavin Jones, Family Life project) are all present. But conflicting 'current role' framings (leadership coach vs. social entrepreneur vs. Founding Director of Participle, an organisation that has ceased) and the wrong-person blocks could lead a reader astray.
